top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli) recognises a mechanism-level principle: a bifunctional molecule forms a ternary complex whose cooperativity is a measurable design variable that turns binding into elimination. It is widely reproduced and structure-guided, and a PROTAC-centred citation can be drawn without claiming clinical success or the molecular-glue strand. Credit omissions (Sakamoto, Kim, Handa, Ito, Gray) must be defended openly. P002 (Buchwald, Hartwig) is mature with clean two-person credit but extends an area already recognised in 2010, so it ranks second. No award is last because both proposals are scientifically sound.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no stake in B011 or B055, and Stockholm University colleague Xiaodong Zou is not a candidate
